messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED: router.us-west-2 streaming p99 spike > 3s (routing-stream-proxy). Auto-paging #incidents and PD escalation
sre_monica: oncall here. pulling up p95/p99 panels. p95 ~280ms, p99 ~3.2s. impact concentrated in us-west-2 AZ-b. no global 5xx increase, mostly stalls/long tail. any recent network or LB changes?
eng_harpreet: we flipped a change to LB controller to add an optional X-Client-Affinity header for canary trials at ~2026-03-15T02:07Z. intended canary-only but rollout tooling shows ~25% reached in the region.
infra_lee: confirming rollout timeline. lb-controller job executed at 02:05Z, propagated to edge proxies by 02:07Z. logs show header insertion and a change in hash key used by the router.
sre_monica: seeing many "handoff" and "reassign" events in router logs around 02:08-02:10Z with matching spikes in "kv-miss" rates. sample logs:
```
2026-03-15T02:08:12Z WARN route-mgr: handoff shard=shard-942 prev=zone-a next=zone-c
2026-03-15T02:08:14Z WARN route-mgr: simultaneous-reassign shard=shard-942 candidates=3
2026-03-15T02:08:21Z ERROR stream-proxy: stall id=xyz123 seq=1102 backend=dedicated-11 latency=3182ms
2026-03-15T02:09:05Z INFO kv-cache: miss shard=shard-942 key=lead-frame rewarm=false
```
support_zoe: customer ops seeing tickets from Streamly and PrimeFeed complaining about streaming stalls and client timeouts (~30-60s). no 5xxs, mostly client aborts and resumed partial frames. escalating to accounts.
pm_maya: sending a short customer notice: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency in us-west-2 AZ-b affecting some streams; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with RCA."
eng_harpreet: immediate mitigation: pausing LB header rollout, re-scoping it to canary only, and enabling router prefer-local fallback. issuing commands now:
```
# pause rollout
lbctl rollout pause --name affinity-header --region us-west-2
# set router fallback
rctl policy set --region us-west-2 --prefer-local true --cross-zone-threshold 4%
```
eng_harpreet: pause acknowledged; prefer-local applied. should converge in ~60-90s.
infra_lee: also increasing streaming worker pool by +25% in AZ-b to absorb tail pressure and starting targeted KV rewarm for top keys in hot shards (shard-942, shard-947).
eng_harpreet: rewarm command queued: `./tools/kv_warm --region usw2 --shards shard-942,shard-947 --top 300`
sre_monica: after 2m, p99 down from 3.2s -> 1.1s; stall counts reduced ~72%. small residual noise on two shards. good progress but keep monitoring for 30m.
qa_sam: reproduced a failure mode in staging: when affinity header is present during a rolling ejection, hash ordering becomes nondeterministic across routers, causing different primaries to be chosen momentarily and producing cache cold misses. failure reproducible with high ejection churn. filing Q-9412.
eng_harpreet: preliminary root cause hypothesis: header injection changed effective hash input; combined with synchronous ejection/rejoin cycles this caused asymmetric routing decisions across edge routers -> tight hot partitions and KV cache cold-starts -> streaming tail stalls at p99. Also noticed duplicate propagation records from the rollout controller in the logs which could cause transient inconsistent state.
support_zoe: logged affected customers and created tickets: STREAMLY-430, PRIME-218. offering short-term dedicated pool switches where possible.
infra_lee: found a set of kube preStop hooks with very short grace periods in AZ-b that likely caused abrupt pod removals at 02:04-02:06Z, contributing to ejections. saving pod termination logs for postmortem.
sre_monica: live mitigation checklist status:
- [x] paused LB rollout
- [x] applied router prefer-local / cross-zone cap
- [x] scaled streaming workers +25% AZ-b
- [x] started KV rewarm for hot shards
- [ ] audit rollout controller for duplicate propagation records
- [ ] add canary enforcement and strict region-scoping to rollout tooling
- [ ] metric for concurrent-shard-reassigns and header-impact
eng_harpreet: patching rollout controller to dedupe propagation events and add a canary gate now. Will open PR and escalate for expedited review.
infra_lee: ops follow-ups: extend graceful termination window for streaming pods, add alert for excessive simultaneous shard reassigns, and add a short jitter to ejection decision to reduce simultaneous reassigns during weight changes.
pm_maya: drafting customer-facing RCA summary to go out after postmortem. include affected window: 02:05-02:22Z, mitigation steps, and offer logs/assistance.
sre_monica: timeline for postmortem:
- 02:04Z kube preStop events causing some abrupt ejections
- 02:05Z LB affinity rollout job executed (unexpected wider scoping)
- 02:08Z p99 starts climbing, alerts fire
- 02:09Z pause rollback + prefer-local applied
- 02:12Z scaling and KV rewarm underway
- 02:20Z p99 back to SLO range
- 03:00Z monitoring stable

sre_monica: assigning postmortem: owner eng_harpreet, infra reviewer infra_lee, SRE reviewer sre_monica, QA reviewer qa_sam. Draft due in 72h. Severity classified Sev3.
support_zoe: contacted account teams for impacted customers; offering extended log bundles and postmortem once ready.
deploy-bot: rollback detected and verified at 02:09:12Z; no further LB rollouts in region after that.
eng_harpreet: I'll lead the RCA and include a clear corrective action list: stronger canary scoping, rollout dedupe, ejection backoff logic, and KV rewarm automation for hot shards.
sre_monica: handing off to night oncall @sre_kai at 03:30Z. channel will remain open for 2h. if latency regresses, call bridge immediately. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
